luiskr.com / core/utils/canvas/dom-font / syncCanvasFont

function syncCanvasFont(ctx, st): void

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/dom-font.ts:114

Configures a 2D context so fillText/measureText reproduce the DOM element's typography exactly: shorthand font (style/weight/size/family) plus every extra axis via applyFontExtras, and the element's resolved ink color. Callers still pick textBaseline/textAlign.

Parameters

ctx

CanvasRenderingContext2D

Canvas 2D context being configured.

st

CSSStyleDeclaration

Computed style of the source text element.

Returns

void
